title: Take up your cross

lines.text: Take up your cross and follow Jesus,
Take up the cross every day;
Don't be ashamed to say that you know Him,
Count the cost take up the cross

chords:
[Verse]
[D]Take up your cross and follow [G]Jesus,
[D]Take up the cross every [A]day;
Don't be [D]ashamed to say that you know [G]Him,
Count the [D]cost take up the [A]cross
And [D]follow Him.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Take up your cross and follow Jesus,
Take up the cross every day;
Don't be ashamed to say that you know Him,
Count the cost take up the cross
And follow Him.
